## Report PDFs now match the page they came from

The last release put your report charts into PDF exports. Three things were
still missing, and this release fixes all of them.

### What's new

- **The metric cards are in the PDF.** Every report's KPI boxes — Total Expired,
  This Period, Certifications and the rest — now lead the PDF, under the title
  and above the charts, laid out four to a row exactly as they are on screen.
  They are drawn as real text rather than photographed, so they stay sharp at
  any zoom and can be selected and searched.
- **Charts print side by side.** Charts that sit next to each other on the page
  now sit next to each other in the PDF, keeping their proportions — a wide bar
  chart beside a smaller donut prints 2:1, just as it looks in the browser. A
  chart that spans the full width of the page still gets the full width. If your
  browser window is narrow enough that the report stacks its charts, the PDF
  stacks them too, so the file always matches what you were looking at.
- **"Top 10 Trainings" is no longer missing from Achievement Over Time.** That
  panel was the one chart on any report that could not be captured. It is now a
  proper bar chart — clearer on screen as well as in the export — sitting beside
  the completions chart in both places.

### Fixed

- Characters such as `≤`, `→` and en dashes came out as mojibake in PDF exports
  (a KPI reading "Lapsed ≤ 1 month" printed as `Lapsed "d 1 month`). They are now
  written in a form the PDF fonts can render, in report tables as well as the new
  metric cards.

### Also

- The Export menu's tickbox is now **"Include charts & metrics in PDF"**, since it
  governs both. Your existing preference carries over, and it still applies to PDF
  only — CSV and Excel exports are unchanged, so scheduled exports keep working
  exactly as before.
